details.completeness_justification: All core material information from the fixed criteria is adequately represented in the candidate summary. K1 covers revenue growth and EBITDA improvement. K2 covers CARR growth, new sales, CAC payback, and churn rate changes. K3 covers product suite expansion. K4 covers new customer acquisition and partner-driven growth. K5 covers operational efficiency improvements. K6 covers financing and equity details. K7 covers 2026 guidance targets. Only K8 (Iberia region performance details) is missing, but this does not change the overall understanding of the report as the core financial, metric, product, and guidance information is fully captured.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements are logically connected and support the overall narrative of improved financial performance and strategic progress. There are no self-contradictions, logical gaps, or organizational issues. While there is a mention of increased churn rate (S12), this is presented as a counterpoint to other positive metrics without contradiction. The summary flows logically from revenue growth through profitability metrics to operational developments and future guidance. All numerical relationships are presented without implying they should arithmetically reconcile (e.g., segment figures vs consolidated totals), and no internal contradictions are present.
